outcomes.name: The sponsorship and governance approach has been refined based on pilot learnings
The sponsorship and governance approach is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Strategic Direction & Leadership to identify what needs to change in the sponsorship and governance approach before scaling.
Refine the sponsorship and governance approach to Strategic Direction & Leadership based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined sponsorship and governance approach covering Strategic Direction & Leadership ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined sponsorship and governance approach for Strategic Direction & Leadership is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the sponsorship and governance approach for Strategic Direction & Leadership remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the sponsorship and governance approach affected People Experience & Culture.
Adapt the sponsorship and governance approach relating to People Experience & Culture for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the sponsorship and governance approach covering People Experience & Culture to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor People Experience & Culture among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the sponsorship and governance approach for People Experience & Culture.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the sponsorship and governance approach affected Planning & Risk.
Adapt the sponsorship and governance approach relating to Planning & Risk for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the sponsorship and governance approach covering Planning & Risk to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Planning & Risk among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the sponsorship and governance approach for Planning & Risk.
